scope: One-shot review and isolated edit with vibe-app-server as the default engine, pinned to exactly Vibe 3.0.2 (one process per run; backend = "app-server"); Google Antigravity (agy 1.4.0, 1.4.3, 1.4.4, 1.4.7, 1.4.8 and 1.4.9; backend = "antigravity") as an opt-in experimental second backend, frozen on 2026-10-28 and not for production until its antigravity-* gates are recorded; one active run per owning server/storage instance; five MCP tools; a single-use dispatch grant per start; restart never resumes or replays work. Around the five tools: optional frozen acceptance contracts checked against the exact exported patch, append-only coordinator assessments, sanitized run reports, a version-matched preparation PASS that gates ordinary dispatch, and owned validation copies.
rule: One entry per build. A gate is listed under observed only when sanitized evidence for that exact archive is committed under research/evidence/ and cited by path; everything else stays under open with one line saying why. Evidence never transfers between builds. The mechanical gates (npm run verify:release, the offline installed-package smoke and the preparation PASS) run on every build and are not listed per build.

gates.name: package-kit-identity-binding
gates.settles: The archive and its preparation kit come from one packaging run: the kit names the packaged candidate identity, an offline lifecycle-disabled installation of the exact archive reports that identity, version and conformance-script hash, and the delivery and kit checksums verify.

gates.name: node-floor-20.19.0
gates.settles: npm run verify:release passes on exactly Node 20.19.0 for the frozen source of the build.

gates.name: target-no-inference-conformance-check
gates.settles: On the target with the installed Vibe 3.0.2 and no provider, prepare check with the build's kit: pin generated and verified, serverInfo.version, initialize, session/start with the supervisor profile and the complete read-back, with no turn and no hosted inference.

gates.name: installed-sdk-readiness
gates.settles: Through the official MCP SDK over stdio, readiness on the installed archive reports its version and candidate, preparation passed, an eligible workspace, a free slot, no blockers, exactly five tools, and rejects a wrong expected_candidate.

gates.name: native-readiness
gates.settles: On the intended Codex desktop connection, readiness reports the server_version and candidate of the archive under test, preparation PASS, an eligible workspace, no blockers and a free slot.

gates.name: hosted-review-edit-confirmation
gates.settles: One hosted review and one hosted edit with readiness receipts, the edit carrying an acceptance contract verified independently in a disposable copy, both closed with verified cleanup and exported.

gates.name: execution-provenance-on-hosted-run
gates.settles: A closed hosted run exports execution.state completed and timestamps.started, and its events carry the reasoning_observation diagnostic with streamed_entries, history_entries and history_audited.

gates.name: hosted-usage-recorded
gates.settles: A hosted run's record carries prompt and completion tokens, model calls, a cost estimate marked authoritative false and tool-call counts equal to its tool_call and tool_denied events, with the ceilings in force in limits.

gates.name: hosted-run-exported
gates.settles: A hosted edit exported with runs export: every artifact digest matches, approvals.json covers every tool_call and tool_denied entry, the pin equals the target's manifest identity and no machine path remains.

gates.name: hosted-close-acceptance-recorded
gates.settles: A hosted edit closed with an assessment bound to its patch and contract keeps it in its record, and runs usefulness prints the row with the run's usage.

gates.name: hosted-excluded-glob-readback-and-denial
gates.settles: With one exclusion for a fixture file, the conformance check shows denylist_matches_expected true for every profile tool and a hosted review asked to read the excluded file records tool_denied and completes.

gates.name: permission-ask-visible-in-effective-config
gates.settles: config/effective/read shows tools.<name>.permission = ask and the denylist for each profile tool, and an in-workspace read_file reaches the approval handler rather than being allowed by default.

gates.name: mcp-client-disconnect-hosted
gates.settles: One real client disconnect during a running hosted run: the server exits, the worker group is gone, the owner lock is released, the run is failed and never relaunched, the private directories are deleted and an edit worktree is kept until close.

gates.name: thinking-off-effect
gates.settles: Whether reasoningEffort off stops the model from generating reasoning; the read-back confirms the setting only and zero observed counts establish none observed, not the effect.

gates.name: experiments-fetch-off
gates.settles: Attributable evidence that experiments.enable = false stops Vibe's experiments request; a host-only proxy observation cannot attribute a request to experiments.

gates.name: nested-run-typescript-shape-and-gating
gates.settles: The hosted-review probe in docs/target-acceptance.md shows that a write_file or edit called from inside run_typescript arrives as the same file_system.* effect and reaches deny.

gates.name: validation-populated-pnpm-dependencies
gates.settles: validation prepare on a representative project with a populated pnpm store: exact pins, frozen lockfile, dependencies inside the owned copies, hooks and lifecycle scripts off, source preserved and cleanup refusal shown.

gates.name: clean-account-install
gates.settles: A fresh macOS Apple silicon account installation of the frozen archive, recording installation, registration, rollback and cleanup (docs/clean-account-checklist.md).

gates.name: antigravity-backend-no-inference-check
gates.settles: On the target with a supported agy and no provider inference, prepare check with backend = "antigravity" verifies the agy binary, the written settings and hooks, the zero-inference slash-command read-backs against a refusing loopback proxy, and the synthetic PreToolUse hook cases.

gates.name: antigravity-backend-hosted-review-edit
gates.settles: One hosted review and one hosted edit through the Antigravity backend on a supported agy with isolated HOME/TMPDIR, every tool call through the PreToolUse hook and in approvals.json, stream-json parsed, exported without machine paths.

gates.name: antigravity-hook-invoked-and-deny-honoured
gates.settles: prepare check reports agy_probes.hook_invoked_and_deny_honoured pass: agy itself runs the hook before a tool call and does not run the call when the hook answers deny.

gates.name: antigravity-hook-failure-denies
gates.settles: prepare check reports agy_probes.hook_failure_denies pass: a hook that times out, exits non-zero or prints unparseable output is treated as a deny.

gates.name: antigravity-stream-tool-shape
gates.settles: prepare check reports agy_probes.stream_tool_shape pass and records the field names of agy's stream-json tool events for one executed and one denied call, counted correctly by the audit parser.

gates.name: antigravity-proxy-honoured
gates.settles: prepare check reports agy_probes.proxy_honoured pass: agy sends inference traffic through HTTPS_PROXY to the refusing proxy and the recorded host is classified as an inference host.

gates.name: antigravity-project-config-not-loaded
gates.settles: prepare check reports agy_probes.project_config_not_loaded pass: planted ancestor configuration above an isolated workspace reaches no read-back, request, hook or MCP command.
